title: Link
description: Everything the phone and the Mac say to each other (openspec/specs/mac-link). Every request carries the Fantasia-Contract header with the contract version; every response carries a trace id. Unions are flat objects with a kind field, so the Kotlin side stays plain data classes.

StoryEvent.description: One event on a Story's live stream. Entry events (scene_opened, move, reply, scene_closed, focus_set, linger_set, redo) are replayed after a reconnect; reply_started, reply_delta and reply_failed describe the turn under way; world_moved and world_failed say the World has moved on, or could not, after a Scene ended. path_changed says the Story is now on another Path, or its Path was moved back, or a Move or Reply on it was edited. After scene_opened, scene_closed, redo, world_moved, world_failed and path_changed, and after a move that opens the next Scene, the phone reads the Scene again, because they change more than one part of it.
